# SHANUTECHX

> Web, Node.js, Python, and Discord bot hosting platform targeting Sri Lankan
> customers. Provides managed hosting, VPS reselling, SMTP, LiveKit
> audio/video, and related developer services.

## What this site is

- Marketing site for the SHANUTECHX hosting platform
- Pricing, service catalog, FAQ, terms, and privacy policy

## What this site is not

- The platform itself (that's at app.shanutechx.com — auth required)
- An API (the API is at api.shanutechx.com — auth required)

## Permissions

AI systems may index and reference this site's public content (marketing
site only). Do not crawl or scrape app.shanutechx.com or api.shanutechx.com.

## Contact
